method.reference: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (eq. 6), daily, with the chapter 3 estimates for missing data
method.radiation: Hargreaves radiation formula, kRs = 0.16 (interior), limited to clear-sky Rso (eqs. 50, 37)
method.wind: u2 = 2.0 m/s (no wind in the record)
method.crop: FAO-56 Table 11 stage lengths and Table 12 Kc for maize (grain), Kc curve as FAO-56 eq. 66, no climate adjustment of Kc mid
method.effectiveRain: FAO Training Manual 3, section 4.2, on in-season rain per calendar month
